result.stdout:
docmon 0.1.1 - a terminal UI for managing and monitoring your Docker stack.

Usage:
  docmon               Connect to the local Docker daemon and open the TUI.
  docmon --no-splash   Skip the startup splash screen.
  docmon --version     Print the version and exit.
  docmon --help        Print this help and exit.

Docker endpoint: unix:///var/run/docker.sock (override with DOCKER_HOST).
